_what: Route 2 pre-registration. Frozen before the test fold is run.
_status: research candidate, not an app default
_qualifier: Pareto optimality applies only to regional MSE/RMS under the identical feasible set; it does not imply Pareto optimality for CVaR, EPI displacement, signal dropout, or measured EPI image quality.
_rest_budget_meaning: A 1% rest-RMS budget bounds one scalar summary of one region. It does not mean the rest of the brain is undamaged in EPI: nothing here measures displacement, dropout or image quality.

operating_point.definition: minimise PFC RMS subject to rest RMS <= (1 + budget) * rest RMS of the production whole-brain solution, under the identical feasible set
operating_point.reference_solution: core.adaptive_joint.solve_adaptive_joint with uniform weights and lambda_pfc_low=0, i.e. the shipping whole-brain solve

candidate.form: epsilon-constraint SOCP on the factored normal form; min ||R_p x + u_p||^2 s.t. ||R_r x + u_r|| <= cap, box on x
candidate.reduction: design matrices reduced to their 20x20 Cholesky factor before reaching CVXPY; no million-row matrix is handed to the solver

reference._note: alpha = 0 and top_fraction = 0 means uniform voxel weights: the reference is the plain whole-brain mean-square solve, with no adaptive weighting

solver._clipping_note: a solution violating its constraints raises GuardViolation; it is never clipped

masks.rest: brain & ~pfc, strictly disjoint from pfc; air excluded

exclusions.reason: radian-scale phase written into a file named hertz; values reach 0.997 x 3*pi and are identical between two different participants

split.grouping: by participant, not by scan: repeat sessions and the with/without-earshim pairs share anatomy

bounds.rule: per-term intersection: lo = max(-delta, -abs - baseline), hi = min(+delta, +abs - baseline); asymmetric whenever the baseline is non-zero
bounds._policy: a deliberately conservative deployment envelope inside the scanner's real capability; expected to bind, and binding is the policy being enforced

provenance.git_note: the repository has no commits yet, so there is no commit to record; SHA-256 of each file's bytes is given instead
provenance.cleanup_note: path-only repository cleanup; numerical definitions and results unchanged. Scripts moved from tests/ to tools/research/ and the recorded SHA-256 updated to the moved files.

metrics.shared_f0: one centre frequency for the whole head, equal to the negated in-brain mean of the residual, built into the design by centring every column on its in-brain mean; PFC and rest are never demeaned separately

primary.name: pfc_rms
primary.definition: root mean square of the residual over the PFC mask after the shared f0, in Hz

constraint.name: rest_rms
constraint.definition: same quantity over brain & ~pfc; capped at (1 + budget) x the reference solution's value

metrics._std_note: region-centred standard deviations demean each region separately and hide a genuine frequency offset between them; kept only for comparison with figures produced before the shared f0 was settled
